hero.badge: The Best packaging service in Egypt
hero.lead: We manufacture and print bags, sacks, cartons and labels from our workshop in Mohandessin, Giza. we design it, print it, and ship it anywhere in Egypt and the Arab world.
hero.art_alt: Printed packaging produced by Media Print Pack
prod.h2: One workshop, every kind of packaging
prod.lead: From a zipper bag for a spice brand to five-ply corrugated cartons for a shipping line — printed, finished and delivered by the same team.
p.zipper.d: Zipper bags made plain or printed in one or two colours, in every size, as a single layer or two-ply lamination.
p.sacks.d: High-quality printed paper sacks in three plies, with an optional inner plastic layer — and we take small runs.
p.apparel.d: Clear polyester garment bags with a frosted 3-mil zip lock, resealable and quick to pack — no extra tape or materials needed.
p.nonwoven.d: Sturdy fabric totes sized for shopping, storage and giveaways — completely food-safe and reusable.
p.courier.d: Shipping bags in a strong material with a reliable seal, and a front pouch for the shipping label.
p.paperbags.d: Paper carriers in coated or kraft stock, printed or plain, finished to match your brand.
why.h2: Fewer people between you and the finished box
why.lead: From the first sample to the pallet leaving our door, this is what actually changes when the workshop printing your packaging is the one that made it.
why.3.d: Printed bags start at 1,000 and printed sacks at 300 — you do not have to commit to a container to get your own packaging.
why.1.d: Design, printing and finishing happen in the same place, so nobody can pass the blame and nothing gets lost between suppliers.
why.2.d: You see and approve a physical sample before we produce the quantity. What you sign off on is what you get.
why.4.d: We ship to every governorate in Egypt, and to the Arab countries.
clients.h2: Brands that already print with us
clients.lead: From multinationals to growing local labels — a selection of the names we have produced packaging and print for.
proc.h2: Four steps from enquiry to delivery
proc.1.d: Message us on WhatsApp or call with the type of packaging, the sizes and roughly how many you want.
proc.2.d: Our team prepares the artwork, or reviews and print-proofs the design you already have.
proc.3.d: We produce a sample. You check the material, the colours and the finish, then approve it.
proc.4.d: The run is produced and shipped to your door anywhere in Egypt or the Arab world.
ind.lead: If your product needs to sit on a shelf, survive a courier, or carry your name — we have probably packed something like it.
srv.lead: The same press that prints your packaging handles the rest of your printed material.
s.metalize.d: Strong-adhesive metalized stickers for polyethylene and polypropylene packs.
s.notepad.d: Every size, made to your specification, printed inside in up to four colours.
s.rollup.d: Roll-up banners for exhibitions, showrooms and points of sale.
band.h2: Send us your product, we will tell you how to pack it
band.p: A message on WhatsApp with the type of product, the size and the quantity is enough to get a price back. Sales: 01005750973.
ft.about: A printing and packaging workshop in Mohandessin, Giza. We manufacture bags, sacks, cartons and labels, print them, and ship them across Egypt and the Arab world.
ft.rights: © 2026 Media Print Pack. All rights reserved.
ph.best.lead: The packs our customers reorder most, with live pricing on every size and quantity.
p.corrugated.d: Treated kraft board that protects the product in transit — three or five plies.
p.tags.d: Card stock in several weights, punched with string, printed one or two sides.
p.alu.d: Three-side seal pouches for coffee, supplements and dry food. Printed or plain.
best.note: Prices exclude VAT and are confirmed on the sample before production.
ph.products.lead: Everything we manufacture and print, with the materials, finishes and minimums for each. Filter by material, or ask us and we will point you to the right one.
p.stickers.d: Printed adhesive stickers turn any surface into brand space — for packs, products and sealing.
p.cartons.d: Printed boxes for cosmetics and retail products, finished so the pack earns its place on the shelf.
p.sacks5.d: Two-ply sacks for fertilisers, pesticides, coffee, supplements, clothing and chemicals — with a zip, a base and gussets.
p.sacks5.s1: Printed up to 2 colours from 300 sacks
p.sacks5.s2: Plain from 100 sacks (black, white, yellow, green, red)
ph.stick.lead: Paper, plastic, transparent and metalized stickers, die-cut to any shape, for packs, products and sealing.
ph.services.lead: Commercial printing alongside the packaging — stickers, stationery, marketing print and display.
s.letterhead.d: Company stationery and notebooks, consistent with the rest of your identity.
s.sticker.d: Stickers on paper or plastic stock, for large runs and short ones alike.
s.duplex.d: Printed duplex board boxes, sized and finished around the product they hold.
s.flyer.d: Marketing print produced at high quality, in the quantity you actually need.
s.promo.d: Branded giveaway bags carrying your logo, for events and campaigns.
srv.extra.d: Professional design, a sample before final production, and shipping to Egypt's governorates and the Arab countries.

meta.title.home: Media Print Pack — Printed Packaging Manufacturer in Egypt
meta.desc.home: Zipper bags, paper sacks, courier bags, non-woven totes, printed cartons and labels. Manufactured and printed in Mohandessin, Giza. Samples before production, shipping across Egypt and the Arab world.
meta.desc.best: Our most reordered packaging: garment bags, kraft bags, corrugated boxes, hang tags, aluminium pouches and fabric totes — with live tiered pricing.
meta.desc.products: Full catalogue of packaging we manufacture and print: zipper bags, paper sacks, garment bags, courier bags, non-woven totes, paper bags, stickers, printed and corrugated cartons, hang tags and 5kg sacks.
meta.desc.stick: Paper, plastic, transparent and metalized stickers for food, cafes, cosmetics, events and retail. Die-cut to any shape, large and short runs.
meta.desc.services: Metalized stickers, notepads, letterheads, duplex boxes, roll-ups, flyers, brochures, catalogues and promotional bags — printed in-house.
meta.title.book: Book a Meeting — Media Print Pack
meta.desc.book: Book a meeting with Media Print Pack online, at your office, or at ours in Mohandessin, Giza. Saturday to Thursday, 10am to 6pm.
meta.desc.contact: Talk to Media Print Pack: 323 Sudan Street, Mohandessin, Giza. Sales 01005750973 — open Saturday to Thursday, 10am to 6pm.
